A short list for before you open the deals.

Number 1 is my favourite. The day the phone started charging in the kitchen, my sleep got better. In Aviva's sleep survey, 94% of Brits use a screen in the hour before bed, so a £5 alarm clock is a cheap way to be in the other 6%.

Number 2 pairs well with the 16 to 18°C bedroom sleep experts recommend. Heating down, hot water bottle in.
